newsitem.title: UK: Renishaw spikes higher as H1 profits jump.
newsitem.headline: Renishaw spikes higher as H1 profits jump.

text.p: Shares in Renishaw Plc were up 21p or 6.21 percent to 359 by 1300 GMT after the specialist engineering group reported a 32 percent jump in first-half pre-tax profits to 10.785 million stg.
"We saw some good buying after the results--but the market has gone quiet," one market maker said.
Renishaw's principle activities include the design, manufacture, and sale of advanced precision metrology and inspection equipment as well as computer aided design an manufacturing systems.
